description: Drip irrigation systems in Kenya for kitchen gardens, greenhouses and commercial farms. Compare driplines, filters, fittings and complete kits with DripTech Eco Flow support.
h1: Drip irrigation systems for Kenyan farms
intro: Drip irrigation delivers water close to the crop root zone, helping farmers manage water, pressure and fertiliser more precisely. DripTech Eco Flow supplies the parts and complete systems needed for small plots, greenhouses and larger farms across Kenya.

sections.heading: Choose the right system for your crop and plot
paragraphs: The right layout depends on the crop spacing, field shape, water source, available pressure and the number of beds. We help you choose the dripline, filter, fittings, valves and pump capacity before you buy.

For vegetables and other row crops, emitter spacing and flow rate matter as much as the length of the roll. A system sized for the actual beds is easier to operate and maintain than a one-size-fits-all package.

h1: Drip irrigation kit prices in Kenya
intro: A useful drip irrigation kit price depends on more than acreage. Crop spacing, number of drip lines per bed, water pressure, filtration and whether installation is included all affect the final system.

sections.heading: What a complete drip kit normally includes
bullets: Mainline and submain pipe sized for the field
Driplines or drip tape matched to crop spacing
A filter and pressure-control components
Connectors, valves, end caps and fittings

sections.heading: Why prices differ between farms
paragraphs: A kitchen garden, greenhouse and one-acre open field do not need the same number of lines or the same pressure capacity. The crop also changes the row spacing and emitter requirement.

Use the catalogue to compare the current products and kit options. For a complete farm price, share the plot size, crop, water source and location so the bill of materials is sized instead of guessed.

sections.heading: Ask for a practical quote
paragraphs: DripTech Eco Flow supports farmers across Kenya with equipment selection, delivery and installation coordination. A clear quote should show the kit size, included components, installation scope and any items still required at the farm.

title: Driplines for Sale in Kenya | Drip Tape & Emitters | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Buy driplines, drip tape and emitters in Kenya for vegetables, greenhouse crops and open-field farms. Compare spacing, flow and supporting fittings from DripTech Eco Flow.
h1: Driplines and drip tape for sale in Kenya
intro: Driplines are the part of a drip system that places water beside the crop. The correct spacing, wall thickness, flow rate and filtration determine how evenly the field receives water.

sections.heading: Choose spacing for the crop
paragraphs: Common row-crop choices include 15 cm, 20 cm and 30 cm emitter spacing. Closely planted vegetables may need closer emitters, while wider-spaced crops can use a different layout.
The best selection also depends on the bed width, line length, operating pressure and water quality. DripTech Eco Flow can help check those details before you order a roll.

sections.heading: Do not forget the supporting parts
bullets: A suitable filter to protect emitters from blockage
Take-off connectors, grommets and end caps
Mainline and submain pipe
Pressure regulation and flush points
A pump or elevated tank connection when required

sections.heading: Shop the current range
paragraphs: Browse the live drip category for available driplines, emitters, connectors and related products. Product pages include the information available for the current stock item and provide a direct route to ask about delivery or installation.

title: Sprinkler Systems in Kenya | Farm Sprinklers & Installation | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Sprinkler systems in Kenya for farms, nurseries and open fields. Compare sprinklers, rain guns, pipes, pumps and fittings with sizing and installation support.
h1: Sprinkler systems for farms in Kenya
intro: Sprinklers are useful when a farm needs broader coverage than a row-based drip system. The correct sprinkler depends on the crop, application rate, operating pressure, spacing and available water supply.

sections.heading: Sprinklers for different farm layouts
paragraphs: A small plot, nursery, greenhouse perimeter and open field may each require a different sprinkler pattern. Sprinkler spacing should be planned around the throw, wind exposure and the crop's water requirement.
DripTech Eco Flow supplies sprinkler equipment and related pipes, pumps, valves and fittings. The team can help compare a sprinkler layout with drip irrigation when both options could work.

sections.heading: What to check before buying
bullets: Available water flow and operating pressure
Required coverage and sprinkler spacing
Pipe diameter and run length
Pump capacity and power source
Drainage, wind and crop sensitivity

sections.heading: Get the system sized for your farm
paragraphs: Share the field size, crop, water source and location for a more useful recommendation. DripTech Eco Flow can supply the equipment and coordinate installation support across Kenya.

title: Solar Irrigation Pumps Kenya | Solar Pump Systems & Prices | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Solar-powered irrigation pumps for farms in Kenya without reliable grid power. Compare solar pump options and get help sizing a system to your water source and field.
h1: Solar irrigation pumps for Kenyan farms
intro: Solar pumping lets a farm move water where grid power is unreliable or unavailable, with lower running costs than a petrol or diesel pump over time. Sizing a solar pump correctly depends on your water source depth, the flow rate you need, and how many hours of usable sunlight your site gets.

sections.heading: What decides the right solar pump size
bullets: Depth to water (surface, shallow well or borehole)
Required flow rate and daily water volume
Static and dynamic head to your storage tank or field
Available panel space and daily sun hours at your site

sections.heading: Solar irrigation equipment available
paragraphs: DripTech Eco Flow supplies solar irrigation pumps and the panels, controllers and fittings needed to run them, alongside driplines, sprinklers and filtration to complete the system.
A solar pump is only one part of the system — pairing it with the right filtration and dripline or sprinkler layout keeps water use efficient once it reaches the field.

sections.heading: Get help sizing your system
paragraphs: Send your water source, depth, required flow rate and site location on WhatsApp for help matching pump and panel capacity to your farm, or request a quote for a complete solar irrigation setup.

title: Borehole Water Pumps Kenya | Submersible & Solar Options | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Submersible and solar borehole water pumps for irrigation in Kenya. Compare pump options for your borehole depth and yield, and get help sizing the right system.
intro: Once a borehole is drilled and its yield known, the next decision is matching a pump to that depth and yield. DripTech Eco Flow supplies the pumps, controllers and fittings for borehole-fed irrigation — not the drilling itself, which is a specialised hydrogeological service.

sections.heading: Matching a pump to your borehole
paragraphs: A pump sized below your borehole's actual yield runs the risk of dry-running and early failure, while an oversized pump wastes money. Your driller's yield test result and the depth to water are the key inputs.

Submersible electric pumps suit boreholes with reliable grid power; solar submersible pumps suit sites without it, at the cost of pumping only during usable daylight hours unless paired with battery storage.

sections.heading: What DripTech Eco Flow supplies
bullets: Submersible electric and solar borehole pumps
Rising main pipe, cabling and control panels
Filtration to protect downstream drip or sprinkler equipment
Fittings to connect the borehole system to your irrigation layout

sections.heading: Already have a yield test result?
paragraphs: Send your borehole depth, yield and required flow rate on WhatsApp for help choosing a pump, or request a quote for the full pump-to-field setup.

title: Water Storage Tanks for Irrigation Kenya | Sizes & Prices | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Water storage tanks sized for drip and sprinkler irrigation in Kenya. Compare tank sizes against your plot size, pump output and buffer requirements.
h1: Water storage tanks for farm irrigation
intro: A storage tank buffers supply between your water source and the field, smoothing out pump downtime, solar pumping hours, or an intermittent municipal or borehole supply. Sizing it against your daily water demand avoids both running dry mid-irrigation and paying for capacity you never use.

sections.heading: Sizing a tank to your system
paragraphs: A useful starting point is your system's daily water requirement across all beds or zones, plus a buffer for the hours your pump or supply is unavailable — overnight for a solar pump, for example.
Tank position also matters: a raised or elevated tank can supply a basic gravity-fed drip layout without a pump, while a ground-level tank needs a pump to reach field pressure.

sections.heading: What to consider before buying
bullets: Daily water demand across your plot size and crop
Buffer hours needed if your pump or supply is intermittent
Tank placement — raised for gravity feed, or ground-level with a pump
Space and stand/foundation requirements for larger tanks

sections.heading: Get help choosing a tank size
paragraphs: Send your plot size, crop and pump or supply type on WhatsApp for help working out a practical tank size, or request a quote for tank plus the rest of your irrigation system.

title: Greenhouse Drip Irrigation Kenya | Systems for Protected Crops | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Drip irrigation systems designed for greenhouse crops in Kenya. Compare driplines, filtration and fertigation options suited to protected growing conditions.
intro: Greenhouse crops are grown in a more controlled environment than open-field crops, but that makes consistent, clog-free irrigation even more important — there's no rainfall to fall back on if a line blocks. DripTech Eco Flow supplies the drip components and filtration suited to greenhouse growing, though the greenhouse structure itself is a separate build.

sections.heading: What's different about greenhouse irrigation
paragraphs: Greenhouse beds are usually smaller and more uniform than open-field rows, which suits closely-spaced emitters and precise flow control. Good filtration matters more here since a clogged line in a greenhouse can affect a crop faster than an open-field equivalent.
Many greenhouse growers also fertigate — feeding nutrients through the same drip system — which needs a compatible dosing setup alongside the dripline itself.

sections.heading: Equipment for greenhouse irrigation
bullets: Driplines and emitters sized for greenhouse bed spacing
Filtration to protect against clogging in a closed system
Fertigation components for feeding through the drip line
Control and timing equipment for consistent scheduling

sections.heading: Planning a greenhouse system
paragraphs: Send your greenhouse dimensions, crop and bed layout on WhatsApp for help putting together a parts list, or request a quote for the full irrigation setup.

title: Fertigation Systems Kenya | Feed Nutrients Through Drip Irrigation | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Fertigation systems for Kenyan farms and greenhouses, feeding fertiliser through drip irrigation for even nutrient delivery. Compare dosing equipment and get setup help.
intro: Fertigation feeds water-soluble fertiliser through the same drip system that waters the crop, so every plant on the line gets a consistent dose instead of uneven hand application. It works alongside an existing drip layout rather than replacing it.

sections.heading: How fertigation fits into a drip system
paragraphs: A fertigation setup injects a measured amount of dissolved fertiliser into the irrigation line, usually just after the filter and before the line splits into zones, so dosing stays consistent across the field or greenhouse.
Getting the dosing rate right depends on your crop's nutrient program and how often you irrigate — this is worth confirming before buying equipment sized for a different schedule.

sections.heading: Fertigation equipment available
bullets: Fertiliser injectors and dosing pumps
Mixing tanks and venturi injectors
Filtration to protect emitters from dissolved solids
Fittings to integrate with an existing drip layout

sections.heading: Adding fertigation to your system
paragraphs: Send your crop, nutrient program and current drip layout on WhatsApp for help choosing compatible dosing equipment, or request a quote for a complete fertigation setup.
